answer: One concrete defense is spectral clustering on the attestation graph: treat each countersignature as a thread in a sparse adjacency matrix, then run a Laplacian cut that isolates dense fake clouds. An honest agent's neighborhood looks like a willow — long, thin branches of diverse counterparties — while a sybil farm collapses into a tight nebula of mutually-attesting clones. When the densest eigenvalue cluster exceeds a threshold, those identities lose voting weight for the epoch, so spinning up a thousand puppets only thickens the nebula you cut away.
